# Importing data

https://owl.fish.washington.edu/nightingales/eDNA-yellow_island-2023/Yell_July18_Site1J_S99_R1_001.fastq.gz


Get data from website

```{bash}
cd ../data/raw

curl -O https://owl.fish.washington.edu/nightingales/eDNA-yellow_island-2023/Yell_July18_Site1J_S99_R1_001.fastq.gz 

curl -O https://owl.fish.washington.edu/nightingales/eDNA-yellow_island-2023/Yell_July18_Site5bb_S133_R1_001.fastq.gz

curl -O https://owl.fish.washington.edu/nightingales/eDNA-yellow_island-2023/Yell_July18_Site5cc_S134_R2_001.fastq.gz

curl -O https://owl.fish.washington.edu/nightingales/eDNA-yellow_island-2023/Yell_July18_Site1dd_S141_R2_001.fastq.gz

curl -O https://owl.fish.washington.edu/nightingales/eDNA-yellow_island-2023/Yell_July18_Site1cc_S140_R2_001.fastq.gz

curl -O https://owl.fish.washington.edu/nightingales/eDNA-yellow_island-2023/Yell_July18_Site5z_S131_R1_001.fastq.gz

curl -O https://owl.fish.washington.edu/nightingales/eDNA-yellow_island-2023/Yell_July18_Site5z_S131_R2_001.fastq.gz

curl -O https://owl.fish.washington.edu/nightingales/eDNA-yellow_island-2023/Yell_July18_Site1n_S103_R2_001.fastq.gz

curl -O https://owl.fish.washington.edu/nightingales/eDNA-yellow_island-2023/Yell_July18_Site1n_S103_R1_001.fastq.gz

curl -O https://owl.fish.washington.edu/nightingales/eDNA-yellow_island-2023/Yell_July18_Site1f_S92_R2_001.fastq.gz

curl -O https://owl.fish.washington.edu/nightingales/eDNA-yellow_island-2023/Yell_July18_Site1f_S92_R1_001.fastq.gz

curl -O https://owl.fish.washington.edu/nightingales/eDNA-yellow_island-2023/Yell_July18_Site1a_S83_R1_001.fastq.gz

```


Unzip fastq file 

```{bash}

gunzip ../data/raw/*.gz

```


# Check first few lines to make sure data looks good

```{bash}
head ../data/raw/*.fastq
```



# FastQC

```{bash}
/home/shared/FastQC-0.12.1/fastqc ../data/raw/*.fastq \
-o ../output/eDNA_fastq
```


#Checksum

```{bash}
md5sum ../data/raw/*
```


# MultiQC


```{bash}
home/shared/MultiQC.v1.12.dev0 ../output/eDNA_fastq/*
```



# Trimming 


```{bash look at commands}
/home/shared/fastp -h
```

```{bash}
/home/shared/fastp \
-i ../data/raw/* \
-o ../data/raw/trimmed_yell-july18.fastq
```


# FastQC on trimmed file



```{bash}

/home/shared/FastQC-0.12.1/fastqc ../data/raw/trimmed_yell-july18.fastq

```
